name: page-cache
description: Least Recently Used (LRU) page cache manager simulating dirty page flushing, page storage adapters, and block-based disk operations.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to manage in-memory caches for file blocks/pages in custom database storage engines.

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Maximum number of pages held in memory cache (default: 3).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Fixed size of each page in bytes (default: 4096).
